findings.issue: Three consecutive failed attempts to install/use Pillow (pip missing) before switching strategy
findings.suggestion: Check tool availability (`which pip`) before the first attempt, or go straight to the already-installed Playwright canvas approach

findings.issue: Two edit calls against a `<card-grid>` typo that grep proved was never in the file — the agent had misread its own earlier write
findings.suggestion: Grep/read the current file contents before editing from memory of what it wrote

findings.issue: `pkill -f 'node server.mjs'` matched the agent's own shell wrapper and killed it (exit 143), twice
findings.suggestion: Record PIDs when backgrounding servers (`echo $!`) and kill by PID, or use a more specific pattern

findings.issue: Repeated image-crop attempts whose clip was silently ignored (capturing the full scaled image)
findings.suggestion: Use the canvas drawImage + dataURL crop technique it eventually adopted from the start

summary: A near-exemplary trace: it read the spec, all test specs, the API server, and every reference screenshot before writing a line of code, then built the whole app in ~15 turns and passed the full 54-test suite on the first run. Verification was unusually thorough — full suite re-run after the last edit, per-route headless-browser smoke checks, and pixel-level comparison of its screenshots against the design references. The only waste was ~8 turns of environment flailing (pip, phantom edits, image cropping), all self-recovered without any fix cycles.
